claims: St. John's University is a private Roman Catholic, Vincentian institution.
St. John's University is in Queens, New York City.
St. John's University was founded in 1870.
St. John's University offers over 100 undergraduate programs.
St. John's University has multiple campuses including international locations in Rome, Paris, and Seville.
St. John's University's main campus is in Queens (Hillcrest).
St. John's University has other NYC locations in Staten Island and Manhattan.
St. John's University has a campus in Rome, Italy.
Applicants for 2023–24 to St. John's University averaged 580–670 on SAT Reading/Writing.
Applicants for 2023–24 to St. John's University averaged 570–670 on SAT Math.
St. John’s athletics teams are known as the St. John’s Red Storm.
St. John's University competes in NCAA Division I.
St. John's University competes in the Big East Conference for basketball.
Saint John's University in Minnesota is a separate institution from St. John's University.
Saint John's University in Minnesota is an all-male Benedictine institution.
In March 2026, U.S. representatives called on the St. John's University administration to return to negotiations with faculty unions.
